question: A man goes to Jaipur from Surat at a speed of 20km/hr and returns to Surat at speed of 30km/hr, through same route. What is his average speed (in km/hr) of the entire journey?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the distance traveled is constant, the average speed for the entire journey is calculated as: 2xy ÷ (x + y)

Given speeds are x = 20 km/hr and y = 30 km/hr.

⇒ Average speed = (2 × 20 × 30) ÷ (20 + 30)

⇒ Average speed = 1200 ÷ 50 = 24

**∴ The correct answer is 24 km/hr.**
